data.title: Coastline Beach Residences
data.about:
Coastline Beach Residences at Siniya Island, a prestigious project by master developer Sobha Group, features an exclusive collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes within its four elegant towers. Nestled in the tranquil surroundings of Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain, this remarkable project offers panoramic sea views, seamlessly blending contemporary luxury with the island's breathtaking natural beauty.

Designed to deliver a resort-style lifestyle, the residences offer premium amenities such as an infinity swimming pool overlooking the azure waters, a state-of-the-art fitness center, beautifully landscaped parks, and direct beach access. Strategically located, Sobha Siniya Island Coastline Beach Residences ensures seamless connectivity to key destinations, with Dubai just 50 minutes away and Sharjah reachable within 30 minutes.

characteristics_module.title: Why Invest in Coastline Beach Residences at Siniya Island
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Elegant Coastal Residences: An exclusive collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes across four stylish towers, designed to combine contemporary architecture with the tranquility of Siniya Island.
  • Resort-Inspired Amenities: Enjoy an infinity swimming pool overlooking the azure waters, a fully equipped fitness center, lush landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, and private beach access for a truly luxurious lifestyle.
  • Nature’s Tranquility and Beauty: Experience the pristine charm of Siniya Island, renowned for its white sandy beaches, vibrant mangroves, and thriving wildlife, offering an unmatched blend of serenity and natural beauty.
  • Prime Connectivity and Accessibility: Located just 50 minutes from Dubai and 30 minutes from Sharjah, Coastline Beach Residences apartments offer seamless access to the UAE’s bustling urban hubs while maintaining the peaceful ambiance of an island retreat.
  • Tailored for Refined Living: Each residence is thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts, modern interiors, and floor-to-ceiling windows, maximizing the breathtaking sea views and natural light.
  • Exclusive Island Lifestyle: Offers a harmonious blend of privacy, luxury, and connectivity, making it an ideal destination for those seeking an upscale lifestyle away from the city’s hustle.

location_tile.title: Living Amidst the Natural Island beauty at Siniya Island
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Siniya Island offers a serene escape from the city's hustle, surrounded by pristine white sandy beaches, lush mangroves, and vibrant wildlife, perfect for those seeking a peaceful lifestyle. Residents of Coastline Beach Residences, Siniya Island, can enjoy outdoor activities such as beach walks, birdwatching, and exploring the mangroves while staying connected to modern conveniences.

Despite its tranquil setting, Siniya Island provides excellent connectivity to major UAE destinations. As an emerging location, Siniya Island combines luxury, nature, and convenience, making it an attractive choice for investors and homeowners seeking high ROI and long-term value.

  • Umm Al Quwain Mangrove Beach: 10 minutes
  • UAQ National Museum: 12 minutes
  • Dreamland Aqua Park: 20 minutes
  • Al Hamra Mall (Ras Al Khaimah): 30 minutes
  • Sharjah International Airport: 30 minutes
  • Ajman Museum: 35 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport: 50 minutes
